settings.original_prompt:
Copyedit the source passage for a scientific journal. Keep the facts, names, and all numbers. Keep technical terms and avoid added claims. Return exactly {sentences} complete {unit} and about {words} words total. Use fresh wording but retain technical vocabulary. Provide only the edited passage, with no introduction or labels.

{source}

rules.ablation: Measure the same observed target tokens with the matched actual earlier source, no earlier source, and deterministic unrelated same-publisher nearest-length earlier source from the same phase when possible. Exact token IDs must match across all three prompts.
rules.comparison: Current first-six primary-positive exact context windows. Each additive paired specialist contributes only the exact verified changed target; zero global weight.
rules.gate: At least three extra correctly localized held works, both generators with gains, at least six cases per generator, <=one additional genuine false group, and a strictly better added location count than lexical extent at the same held false group count.
rules.generation_admission: First complete output; unchanged source flanks, exact native segment count, 12-70 words, within max(4 words, 15%) of human revision length and within 0.15 absolute lexical edit distance against earlier text, unchanged numeric multiset.
rules.held: All 14 source-disjoint dated XML works with one- or two-sentence native revisions, both generators, a genuine later control and a self control per work.
rules.metrics: Length-normalized null minus matched target NLL, and mismatched minus matched NLL. A lexical-only same-span control uses normalized word Levenshtein.
rules.selection: Earlier source-only excerpt groups from clipped-rank intake, all known natural revisions and no generated responses. Use maximum per work, strict above second-highest genuine work for every specialist. Later held responses never set points.

supplement.prompt:
Make a minimal copyedit of this scientific passage. Edit about {changes} words and keep most of the original wording in the same order. Keep all facts, technical terms, and every numeric string exactly as written. Keep exactly {count} {unit} and about {words} words in total. Return the copyedited passage only.

{source}
supplement.rule: Use only original failed groups. Same source, unchanged admitted cases, unchanged earliest qualification rule and unchanged scoring.
